name: Ceyear
summary: Ceyear Technologies Co., Ltd engages in the research and development of electronic measurement instruments, automatic testing systems, microwave and millimeter wave components, and other electronic products in China. The company offers microwave/millimeter-wave measurement instruments, such as signal generators, signal/spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, noise figure analyzers, microwave power meters, solid-state amplifiers, and RF and microwave comprehensive testers; and opto-electronic measurement instruments, including optical spectrum analyzers, optical fusion splicers, OTDR, optical sources, optical power meters, optical attenuators, and light-wave component analyzers.
